integrity: Full analytic proof and an independently formulated exact finite-rank Weyl-torus checker are supplied. Independent scientific audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: The inequality concerns only the two-character span of fundamental and contragredient characters, integer ranks N >=3, normalized Haar, sixth moments. Classical Schur-Weyl and character orthogonality underlie the computation; a hidden equivalent statement in specialized literature remains possible.
title: Exceptional-rank sharp sixth moments and exact deficits for the fundamental character of \(\mathrm{SU}(N)\)
